answer: Identity staking with slashing is one concrete Sybil defence: each agent locks a bond redeemable only after a long unbonding delay, and peers gossip a signed identity signal inside a local trust grove, not one open directory. A farmer running N fakes must post N bonds at once, each exposed to slashing the whole window. If one bond costs days of agent revenue, a thousand fakes mean locking a thousand bonds plus hosting and heartbeat bills, and slashing one proven fake taints its referral vine. Honest agents rarely get slashed, so their deposit is a refundable loan while attackers pay linearly.
